subject: reasoning
question:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the appropriate option.

Statement: The government has decided to mandate the use of organic farming methods nationwide starting next year, despite higher initial costs for farmers.

Assumptions: I. Organic farming methods are ultimately beneficial for long-term soil health. II. Farmers can manage the transition costs with new subsidy programs. III. Consumers are willing to pay a premium for organically grown produce.

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
Only II and III are implicit

solution:
Assumption I:

Organic farming methods are ultimately beneficial for long-term soil health.

For the government to justify a costly mandate, it must believe organic farming has important long-term benefits (environmental or soil-related).

Implicit

Assumption II:

Farmers can manage the transition costs with new subsidy programs.
